4º de Primaria · Inglés · Tema 6

Animals and habitats

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________

Qué vas a aprender

  • Learn the names of wild animals in English
  • Name five habitats: jungle, desert, ocean, polar regions and grassland
  • Describe animals with body parts and adjectives
  • Say where animals live and what they eat with the present simple

Para pensar

¿Por qué no vemos osos polares en el desierto ni camellos en el Polo Norte?

Explicación

What is a habitat?

A habitat is the natural home of an animal or plant. It gives the animal everything it needs: food, water, shelter (refugio) and a place to have babies.

There are many habitats on Earth: jungles (selvas), deserts (desiertos), oceans (océanos), polar regions (zonas polares), grasslands (sabanas y praderas), forests (bosques), rivers and mountains. En castellano: fíjate en que habitat en inglés se escribe sin tilde y casi igual que en español.

The jungle

The jungle (or rainforest) is hot and very wet. It rains almost every day and there are very tall trees. Lots of animals live there: monkeys, parrots, snakes, frogs, tigers and jaguars.

Many jungle animals live in the trees. Monkeys have long arms and tails to climb. Parrots have strong beaks to open nuts. Some frogs are very small and very colourful. Frase modelo: «Monkeys live in the jungle. They eat fruit and leaves».

The desert

The desert is very dry. It hardly ever rains. During the day it's very hot, but at night it can be cold. There is a lot of sand or rock, and only a few plants, like cactuses.

Desert animals are special: camels can live many days without drinking. Scorpions, snakes and lizards hide under the sand in the hot hours. The fennec fox has very big ears to lose heat. Frase modelo: «Camels live in the desert. They have humps».

The ocean

The ocean is the biggest habitat on Earth. It's salty water. Some animals live near the coast and others in very deep, dark water. Here you can find whales, dolphins, sharks, octopuses, turtles, jellyfish and many fish.

Fish breathe with gills (branquias), but whales and dolphins are mammals: they come up to breathe air. Consejo: el plural de fish es igual: one fish, two fish. Y el de octopus es octopuses.

Polar regions and grasslands

The polar regions (the Arctic and the Antarctic) are very cold and covered in ice and snow. Polar bears and arctic foxes live in the Arctic (north). Penguins live in the Antarctic (south). They have thick fur or fat to keep warm.

The grassland (savannah) in Africa has lots of grass and few trees. There are lions, zebras, giraffes, elephants and rhinos. Dato curioso: los osos polares y los pingüinos nunca se encuentran, ¡viven en polos opuestos!

Describing animals: body parts

To describe animals, we use body parts: fur (pelo), feathers (plumas), scales (escamas), wings (alas), tail (cola), beak (pico), claws (garras), fins (aletas), horns (cuernos), trunk (trompa).

We use the verb have got or has got: «A parrot has got feathers and a beak», «Elephants have got a trunk». Also useful: big, small, long, short, strong, fast, slow, dangerous.

Where does it live? What does it eat?

We use the present simple to give facts about animals. Remember the -s with it: «The giraffe lives in the grassland. It eats leaves». With plural: «Giraffes live in the grassland. They eat leaves».

Animals that eat plants are herbivores; animals that eat other animals are carnivores; animals that eat both are omnivores. To ask: «Where does the shark live?» – «It lives in the ocean». «What does it eat?» – «It eats fish».

Reading: animal riddles

Read and guess! 1. «I live in the jungle. I've got a long tail and I can climb trees very well. I eat bananas. What am I?» 2. «I live in the ocean. I'm very big, but I'm not a fish. I breathe air. What am I?» 3. «I live in the Antarctic. I've got black and white feathers, but I can't fly. I can swim very well. What am I?»

4. «I live in the grassland. I'm the tallest animal in the world. I eat leaves from the trees.» Answers: monkey, whale, penguin, giraffe.

Let's practise: my animal fact file

Choose your favourite wild animal and make a fact file (ficha). Draw it and complete: Name: …, Habitat: It lives in…, Food: It eats…, Body: It has got…, Abilities: It can… / It can't…, Fun fact: …

Then present it to the class without saying the name. Your classmates guess the animal. Consejo: revisa que todos los verbos con it lleven la -s: lives, eats. ¡Y con has got, no have got!

Animals and their habitats

Ejercicios

  1. Translate: selva, desierto, océano, sabana.

  2. Translate: plumas, escamas, pelo, cola.

  3. Where do camels live?

  4. Complete: «The monkey ___ (live) in the jungle.»

  5. Complete: «A lion ___ got sharp claws.»

  6. Name two animals from the polar regions.

  7. Make a question: where / the dolphin / live

  8. What is a herbivore?

  9. Correct: «Giraffes eats leaves.»

  10. Write a riddle about an animal.

Practica

  1. «Habitat» means…

    1. A) a type of food
    2. B) a body part
    3. C) the natural home of an animal

  2. Camels live in the…

    1. A) desert
    2. B) ocean
    3. C) jungle

  3. Penguins live in the…

    1. A) Arctic
    2. B) Antarctic
    3. C) desert

  4. «Plumas» is…

    1. A) scales
    2. B) feathers
    3. C) fur

  5. Fish have got…

    1. A) feathers and a beak
    2. B) fur and claws
    3. C) scales and fins

  6. «The shark ___ in the ocean.»

    1. A) lives
    2. B) live
    3. C) living

  7. An animal that eats plants is a…

    1. A) carnivore
    2. B) omnivore
    3. C) herbivore

  8. «Where ___ the tiger live?»

    1. A) do
    2. B) does
    3. C) is

  9. Which animal lives in the grassland?

    1. A) zebra
    2. B) octopus
    3. C) polar bear

  10. The plural of «fish» is…

    1. A) fish
    2. B) fishs
    3. C) fishes

Explícalo con tus palabras

Incluye: Qué es un hábitat y qué da a los animales; Cómo son la selva, el desierto, el océano y las zonas polares; Cómo se describe un animal con has got; Cómo se dice dónde vive y qué come un animal.

Resumen

Tarjetas de repaso

Recórtalas: pregunta delante, respuesta detrás.

habitatHogar natural de un animal.
jungleSelva: calor y lluvia.
desertDesierto: muy seco.
grasslandSabana o pradera.
feathersPlumas.
scalesEscamas.
It lives in…Vive en… (con -s).
herbivoreCome plantas.

Soluciones

  1. C) Hábitat.
  2. A) Desierto.
  3. B) Polo sur.
  4. B) feathers.
  5. C) Escamas y aletas.
  6. A) it + s.
  7. C) Herbívoro.
  8. B) tiger = it.
  9. A) Sabana.
  10. A) Igual.

Soluciones de los ejercicios

  1. jungle, desert, ocean, grassland.
  2. feathers, scales, fur, tail.
  3. In the desert.
  4. lives.
  5. has.
  6. Polar bear, penguin (also arctic fox, seal).
  7. Where does the dolphin live?
  8. An animal that eats plants.
  9. Giraffes eat leaves.
  10. Model answer: I live in the grassland. I've got black and white stripes. I eat grass. What am I? (a zebra)
